subject: Card declined code 51 but balance is fine
body: I tried paying for groceries three times and the terminal said declined 51. My balance is 900 BHD.
resolution: Stuck authorisation reduced the available balance; Cards team released the hold within 2 hours.

subject: Stuck in login loop after update
body: Since I updated the app yesterday it keeps sending me back to the login screen.
resolution: Device clock was 12 minutes off; enabling automatic date and time fixed it.

subject: Login alert from a device I don't own
body: I got a notification that someone logged in from a Samsung phone in another country. I only use an iPhone.
resolution: Security Operations revoked all sessions, reset credentials and re-verified the customer via video KYC.

subject: Not receiving OTP while travelling
body: I'm in London and the OTP SMS never arrives so I can't approve a transfer.
resolution: Roaming SMS was disabled; customer switched to in-app push approval.

subject: International transfer not arrived after 6 days
body: I sent 2,000 USD to my brother in Manila last week and he still hasn't received it.
resolution: gpi trace showed a hold at the correspondent for a name mismatch; beneficiary name corrected and funds arrived next day.

subject: Returned transfer is missing money
body: My transfer to Germany was returned but 15 EUR is missing from the refund.
resolution: Correspondent fee deducted on return; explained the fee and refunded the outgoing transfer fee as goodwill.

subject: Charges I didn't make on my card
body: There are 4 online purchases from an electronics website I never visited, total 340 BHD.
resolution: Card frozen and replaced, fraud claim raised, provisional credit within 5 business days.

subject: Charged twice at a restaurant
body: The restaurant charged me twice for the same dinner and both payments show as completed.
resolution: Two settled charges confirmed; dispute raised and the merchant refunded one charge.

subject: App crashes on startup
body: Since this morning the app closes immediately when I open it. Pixel 6, Android 14.
resolution: Reinstall did not help; escalated to Mobile Engineering and fixed in release 5.12.1.

subject: How do I enable international payments?
body: I'm travelling to Dubai next week and want to make sure my card works there.
resolution: Guided the customer to Card Controls to enable international payments.
